title: Advanced Writing and Research for the Social Sciences
description: This course will provide students with an opportunity to gain research experience drawing on the methods used in the social sciences. Students will be exposed to the process of research and writing used by social scientists. Student will identify and evaluate previous research, identify a topic of interest for research, conduct a literature review and create a research proposal for an original research project.
prerequisites: Bachelor of Liberal Studies major, or permission of instructor
attributes: Distance Learning ApprovedMeets Graduate Composition and Communication Requirement
